title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Care Desk Calculation Standard: Courtesy Credit on a Late Fee
content:
**Calculation.** On a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the late fee being reversed is the most recent late fee on the account; the missed statement is the statement of the billing period that fee belongs to, its minimum payment due is the missed minimum and its payment due date is the missed due date; an account with no late fee has no courtesy credit. The courtesy credit is the late fee being reversed times 0.4, rounded half up to the cent.

## Quantities and records

| Quantity | Record |
|---|---|
| Late fee being reversed | the account's late fee entries, the latest by transaction date: its amount and its billing period |
| Missed minimum and missed due date | the statement of that billing period: its minimum payment due and its payment due date |

## Worked figures (hypothetical late fees)

| Late fee being reversed | 0.4 of it | Courtesy credit |
|---|---|---|
| USD 43.00 | 17.20 | USD 17.20 |
| USD 32.00 | 12.80 | USD 12.80 |
| USD 28.37 | 11.348 | USD 11.35 |
| no late fee on the account | — | none |

The rounding is half up to the cent on the product, as the third row shows.
